Zomato No Internet Offline Game Interaction

An offline fallback mini-game titled 'Breaking Bread' within the Zomato food delivery app. The user drags a bread loaf paddle horizontally across the bottom of the screen to bounce a descending tomato ball. When the ball collides with the paddle or walls, it rebounds with physics-based velocity while the score counter updates in real time. Upon missing the ball, a red ketchup splatter particle effect triggers at the impact point, followed by a smooth game-over transition where the title logo, final score, replay button, and a return CTA animate into view.
